fields.prefix: the rendered log of blocks 0..t joined with newlines; the line '### window start' (not log text: remove it before rendering or tokenising) stands immediately before block t-7, the window's first block; block t, the window's last block, ends the text; after removing the marker, every line that does not start with a space begins a new block
